resources.string: Ask your friend to open Banafsh, tap the ⋮ menu, choose “Receive server” and point the camera at this QR.
Only the Banafsh app can read this QR.
Pick a server first, then send it.
Ask your friend to tap “Send server” in Banafsh, then hold their QR in front of the frame.
This QR does not belong to Banafsh
To receive a server from your friend, Banafsh needs to read the QR on their phone. The camera is used only for this.
No photo or video is saved or sent.\nThe camera is on only on this screen.
Camera access is off. To scan, allow it in the app settings.
It will connect automatically as soon as the internet is back
